result.title: Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT
result.summary: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究预算受限下 3D 高斯溅射中「高斯该放在哪里」：提出可复用的标签感知分配前端，把 CT、标签与传递函数映射为体素密度并抽取固定 B 个位置，含群体训练的神经先验与七参数可见性感知闭式（VACF），其余属性仍逐患者拟合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可复用、标签感知的固定预算位置分配先验」可能与 LVR 中在有限 latent token/计算预算下决定视觉证据落在何处的问题同构，可作为按相关性分配内部状态容量、避免逐例搜索的参考线索，尚需核查可迁移性。该工作本身面向医学 CT 重建，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
